tickets.title: Assemble survivor administration packet
tickets.text: Assemble the survivor administration packet for Galen Thimblefern including the death certificate, 2016 will, and current household account list for custodian, bank, and insurer notifications.
tickets.evidence: For survivor administration packet assembly, the death certificate, 2016 will, and current household account list were identified as the core packet for custodian, bank, and insurer notifications after Rhea’s death; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-11-08.

tickets.title: Collect Paper Otter Publishing benefits documents
tickets.text: Collect the employer life insurance claim forms and 401(k) distribution paperwork for Galen Thimblefern from Paper Otter Publishing using the provided HR contact information.

tickets.title: Access Recovery Request
